title: The Amityville Horror
blurb: The haunted house on Ocean Avenue: the 1979 hit, a prequel about the murders that came before it, and decades of loose follow-ups.

groups.title: The original films
groups.note: Amityville II is a prequel to the 1979 film.

groups.title: Amityville: The Awakening
groups.note: A sequel in which the characters have seen the 1979 film.

note: There are dozens of unrelated low-budget Amityville films. These are the main ones. Amityville II is a prequel about the murders in the house, The Awakening is set in a world where the 1979 film exists, and the 2005 film is a remake.
